title: Advancing High-Resolution Electron Microscopy and Spectroscopy through Integrating the CEOS Energy-Filtering and Imaging Device into the Monochromated JEOL Atomic-Resolution Multi-Dimensional TEM at the Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research
content: We present our first experiences with the combined system of a CEOS Energy-Filtering and Imaging Device (CEFID) with the monochromated JEOL Atomic-Resolution Multi-Dimensional Transmission Electron Microscope (ARMD-TEM) at the Max Planck Institute for Solid State Research. This state-of-the-art instrumentation promises groundbreaking insights into the electronic and vibrational structure of materials with sub-Angstrom spatial resolution and meV energy resolution.
